title: A thought experiment
label: In the thought experiment, more output still misses the intent

imagine-your-organization-as-a-line.title: Imagine your organization as a line
imagine-your-organization-as-a-line.script: This is a thought experiment, not a measured prediction: faster work does not guarantee the right result. Imagine your organization as a factory line, with documents moving from one work center to the next, a request here, a design there, a finished result at the end. You already know this picture. The old cartoon shows a customer asking for a tire swing and getting a tangle of ropes, because each station built its own version of what the customer asked for.

where-this-is-going.title: Where this is going
where-this-is-going.script: Before we start, here is the route. First, imagine what might happen if AI sped up work at each station. Then we look at what you hand the AI, because it can shape the result. And last, you will see how an AI interview can help build that handover, so you do not have to write it alone.
